Package com.carlcard.simulator.model

Class MonthlyStatement

java.lang.Object
com.carlcard.simulator.model.MonthlyStatement
public final class MonthlyStatement extends Object
Domain object representing a monthly credit card statement. A MonthlyStatement aggregates the line items, daily balances, interest, fees, rewards, and required payments for a single billing cycle.
